deadline_authority.rule: Only dates locally attached to tender/bid/quotation submission or requests-to-participate language can automatically resolve bid timing. items.review_contract: Gate-ready authoritative DCE evidence pack from the current DCE generation. Unknown is never PASS. FINAL_SUPER_GREEN requires every mandatory gate resolved and authoritative deadline reconciliation.

ranking_contract: Recall-first discovery; post-DCE SPM-fit reranking only. Approximately 80% priority lane + 20% evidence-quality exploration lane. No candidate is declared eligible by this rank.
